_approach: The canonical tamborzão skeleton every tutorial converges on: kick on 1 and 3, clap (perc slot) on 2 and 4, with a syncopated ghost kick and ghost clap pushed into the gaps for the 'pumping' feel. Atabaque/timbau rolls sit on tomLow/tomMid, tamborim carries the classic long-short samba-derived figure on the tambourine role, and a continuous low-velocity shaker fills the 16th grid. Swing 0.12 approximates the triplet lean of the original 12-step tamborzão grid on this engine's 16th grid. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
